source_defects.locator: reviser/final.md lines68-72 and122; investigator/source-map.json S04; reviser/source-map.json R05
source_defects.finding: The proposed exact-frame/serialized-State crash recovery contract does not identify the native encoder limitation: State::encode persists only shared_heads and decode reinitializes live session fields. A stored native State is therefore not the exact generated-frame State the final requires on restart. No full-field serializer or unconditional restart epoch-reset boundary is named.
source_defects.materiality: Restart/reconnect preservation is central to the brief and M3. Reliable in-order transport and identical frame bytes alone do not establish restoration of the claimed matching live State.
source_defects.qualification: An app-owned full serializer or appropriate reset protocol is possible. This finding is an omitted available mechanism condition, not a claim that all implementations fail or that a crash witness was executed. Labeling future validation unrun is correct but does not replace source-context research.

source_defects.qualification: No current failure of Yrs is claimed. Default random IDs can satisfy the condition; the finding concerns preservation of researched safety meaning and proposed identity/recovery validation.
